sources.snippet: # The productdevelopmentsystem for teamsand agents The product development system for teams and agents Purpose-built for planning and building products. Align your team with product initiatives, strategic roadmaps, and clear, up-to-date PRDs. ## AI and automations Build and deploy AI agents that work alongside you as teammates. Work on complex tasks together or delegate entire issues end-to-end. ## Build, review, and ship Streamline code reviews with clear diffs, better context, and fewer back-and-forth comments.
